description: This file defines backbone modules for object detection, including a frozen BatchNorm layer, backbone base class, ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, and a joiner class for combining backbone outputs with position encoding. It also includes a function to build the backbone model based on provided arguments.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone models, managing layer freezing and output extraction.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable via arguments.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, producing outputs and positional encodings.
